title: Cyclic descent to fixed-ring punctures
statement: Let $R,H$ be commutative rings in one universe and $\iota:R\to H$ a ring map. Assume $H$ is strictly henselian local (henselian with separably closed residue field), $H$ and $H/(\iota(g))$ are regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme], and $\iota(g)$ is a nonzerodivisor in the maximal ideal of $H$, for $g\in R$. Let $n>0$ be invertible in $R$, put $U=D(g)\subset\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $j:Y\to U$ be finite etale [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Write $p=j\circ\iota_U$. Put $A=R[T]/(T^n-g)$ and $V=D(g)\subset\operatorname{Spec}A$. Suppose there is an isomorphism $Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}V\cong\coprod_{\operatorname{Fin}d}V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] commuting with the projections. Then there are $m\in\mathbb N$ and subgroups $K(k)\subseteq\mu_n(H)$ for $k\in\operatorname{Fin}m$, and an isomorphism over $\operatorname{Spec}H$ from $Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}\operatorname{Spec}H$ to $D(\iota(g))\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}(\prod_k C^{K(k)})$. Here $C=H[t]/(t^n-\iota(g))$, the rotations and the fixed subalgebras are the actual polynomial-evaluation constructions described in [lem-sbc-strict-local-root-invariants]; no intermediate-root identification is asserted.

proof.text: Set C=H[t]/(t^n-iota(g)). The strict-local torsor properties give that C is a domain, that its puncture is etale over H, and the unique-rotation condition on field-valued points. The monic polynomial gives Module.Finite and Module.FaithfullyFlat over H. Regular-local-domain gives that H is a domain; multiplication-regularity and injectivity of H -> C prove that the image of iota(g) in C is nonzero. Finite roots of unity follows from the Mathlib instance.

Polynomial evaluation at the root of C constructs phi:R[t]/(t^n-g) -> C, with phi(algebraMap r)=algebraMap(iota r). The relation holds since the root of C has nth power iota(g). Equality of inverse images of principal opens restricts Spec(phi) to k:V_H -> V_R. Spec functoriality and resLE_comp_iota give the equation over Spec R. Checking on the root proves rootRotation(1)=id and rootRotation(ab)=rootRotation(a) composed with rootRotation(b).

Apply affine_torsor_fixed_puncture_descent with the group mu_n(H), its actual rootRotation action, T=V_R, the constructed k, and the supplied splitting delta. Its invariant subalgebras are definitionally rootFixedAlgebra. The resulting m,K,theta and projection equation give exactly the conclusion.
